headline: I'm Jessie.
I worked in frontend for years, then left for a working holiday in Australia.
paragraphs: I quit my frontend job, spent a year in Australia on a working holiday, then came home and was back at my computer, writing code again.
Lately I have been putting AI into real work bit by bit, instead of leaving it in a demo.
This site does not have one theme. Code, AI, Australia, travel, and ordinary life are already tangled up in mine.
I keep the mistakes, the things I understood later, and the things nobody told me when I needed them.

persona.p1: Writing things down probably came from coding. When I run into a process I do not know, I want to take it apart. When I make a mistake, I want to leave a note for next time.
persona.p2: I am not especially concise. I usually want to tell the bit before and after, because a story can look very different without the context.
persona.p3: There are doubts, mistakes, and later updates here. Things change. If an old post is wrong, I will fix it; I will also leave what I thought at the time.
persona.aside: First comes that year in Australia, then travel, tech, and life. It is not especially tidy, but it is all mine.
